sentences.text: One L O P tells you you’re somewhere on a line.
Two L O Ps taken at the same time cross at a point, and that point is a fix.
Choose objects whose bearings are about sixty to ninety degrees apart, because when lines cross at a shallow angle, a small bearing error moves the fix a long way.
Take the bearings quickly, one after the other, so the boat hasn’t moved much between them.
Mark the fix with a small circle and the time.
